name: Extreme heat
summary: No top-tier heatwave warnings over large populations; Philippines heat index at danger level
state: PAGASA forecast a 'danger' heat index of 42–43°C in nine Philippine localities on 4 Nov, its second-highest category and confined to local areas (GMA). No top-tier heatwave warning covering a large population was found as of 4 Nov. The strong El Niño raises the risk of Southern Hemisphere heat this summer.
for_you: Where heat warnings apply, follow national weather service advice on staying cool and hydrated.
rubric_hit: No heatwave warnings across a major region = Normal

sources.title: GMA News — 9 areas to experience danger-level heat index on 4 Nov

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
